gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-116.929504 44.024043)',4326)::geography, 4600)
  AND p.amenity = 'hospital'
  AND elev.z >= 340;

  FROM target_hospital
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, 1, ST_Transform(geom::geometry, 4326)) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, buffered_area
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(geom::geometry, 4326))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(clipped_rast, true)).*
  FROM 
    clipped_dem
),
valid_hospitals AS (
  SELECT 
    p.poi_name,
    p.geometry

)
SELECT

  vh.geometry,
  (SELECT max_val FROM elevation_stats) AS max_elevation
FROM 
  valid_hospitals vh, elevation_stats
WHERE 
  (SELECT max_val FROM elevation_stats) >= 340;
